standard_scilink.description: SciLink chooses appropriate tools with the electrochemistry skill applied.

optional_deterministic.description: FaradaIQ may calculate technique-specific metrics first when the user enables the GUI option.

scientific_principles: Use electrochemical context rather than treating every curve as spectroscopy.
Use fitting, simulation, or alternative agents when scientifically useful.
Do not select models solely to improve R-squared.
Validate deterministic and fitted results against raw data and metadata.
